title: WealthStable
tagline: Oversimplified stablecoin wallet. Automatically generate yield. 1-click any action.
description:
Stablecoins are still way too hard to use. There are dozens of them across multiple chains, and even though they all represent the same thing—USD—managing them feels far more complicated than it should. To consolidate funds, you’re juggling bridges and swaps. To earn yield, you’re doing approvals and deposits. And on top of that, you need native ETH on every chain you touch.

But stablecoins *should* be the easiest way for regular people to experience web3: they fix today’s remittance issues and often offer better yields than banks.

This app meets users where they are. It uses the same language they hear from traditional retail banks, treats all stablecoins simply as US dollars, earns higher interest automatically, and hides all the crypto complexity—swaps, bridges, gas, and multi-step transactions—so people never have to think about it.
how_its_made:
Smart wallets (AA) are used to bundle transactions and sponsor gas, ultimately enabling any action with 1 click.
Layer Zero for bridging & swapping across chains.

For this hackathon, just supporting a few tokens on a few chains and only depositing to Aave. But this serves to later expand to cover a much wider range of tokens and chains.
